title: Seattle Holiday Food Tour: Delicious Donuts & Holiday Treats
blurb: Your festive adventure begins at Top Pot Doughnuts on 5th Avenue beneath the Seattle Monorail, where “hand forged” donuts take on seasonal flair. Enjoy classics and holiday favorites as we share the story behind this Seattle staple. Next, we head toward the glowing Amazon Spheres to a trendy café serving inventive Latin inspired treats while exploring the city’s blend of tech and culture. Along the way, catch a view of the Space Needle lit up for the holidays. We then visit a beloved bakery founded by a James Beard Award winning chef, known for farm to table excellence and seasonal specialties. Our final stops bring us to Pike Place Market, where we sip warm champurrado, stroll past festive lights, and watch fresh mini donuts made at Daily Dozen. This holiday tour captures Seattle’s spirit through history, culture, and sweet treats.
